jobs.title: Health & Safety Officer - Part Time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Location: Bradford, BD4 Division: Engineering – SWIFT Temps Ltd, Bradford Office Salary: £31,000 – £39,000 per annum pro rata (PAYE) + Holiday Accrual Job Type: Part-Time | 12-Week Temp-to-Perm SWIFT Temps Ltd is currently recruiting on behalf of our valued manufacturing client in Bradford BD4 for an experienced Part-Time Health & Safety Officer. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced H&S professional looking for a flexible part-time position, with working hours potentially suited to those seeking school term-time working arrangements. About the Role Our client is seeking an experienced Health & Safety Officer to join their manufacturing site in Bradford. You will play a key role in promoting a strong Health, Safety and Environmental culture, ensuring compliance with UK legislation and company standards, while providing practical advice and support to the site management team. Ideally, you will have experience within a manufacturing, engineering or machinery-based environment, with a good understanding of PUWER (Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations) and machinery safety. Key Responsibilities * Implement and monitor H&S policies, procedures and risk assessments. * Conduct regular site inspections and H&S audits. * Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses and recommend appropriate corrective actions. * Ensure compliance with current UK H&S legislation and relevant industry standards. * Maintain accurate H&S records, documentation and reports. * Develop and maintain emergency procedures and coordinate emergency drills. * Arrange testing, servicing and maintenance of H&S equipment. * Provide guidance on PPE, machinery safety and safe working practices. * Support the management of PUWER assessments and machinery-related safety requirements . * Lead regular H&S meetings with the site leadership team. * Monitor PPM schedules and ensure inspections, servicing and statutory checks are completed on time. * Identify opportunities for continual improvement in H&S standards and working practices. * Provide practical H&S advice and guidance to employees and management. About You The successful candidate will ideally have: * IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent H&S qualification. * NEBOSH Certificate is preferred but not essential. * Previous experience working in a Health & Safety role, ideally within manufacturing, engineering or a similar environment. * Experience or knowledge of machinery safety and PUWER. * Good knowledge of UK Health & Safety legislation and best practice. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Good organisational and problem-solving abilities. * The ability to identify workplace risks and implement practical solutions. * Good IT and Microsoft Office skills. First Aid and Fire Safety qualifications are desirable but not essential. Working Hours & Flexibility * 15–25 hours per week * Flexible working hours available * School term-time working may be considered for the right candidate * Part-time hours to be agreed with the successful applicant and client What's on Offer? £31,000 – £39,000 per annum pro rata Part-time, flexible working Potential school term-time arrangement 12-week temp-to-perm opportunity Free on-site parking Bradford-based manufacturing environment Long-term permanent opportunity for the right candidate Holiday pay accrued separately How to Apply If you are an experienced Health & Safety professional looking for a flexible part-time opportunity within a manufacturing environment, we would be keen to hear from you. Please send your CV to Mcmillan Serrant at SWIFT Temps Ltd – Bradford Office. Phone: (phone number removed) INDBR

jobs.title: Service Coordinator Part time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Service Coordinator £14.46 - £16.37 per hour 18.5 hours per week | 6-month fixed-term contract | Hybrid/flexible working We're recruiting for a Service Coordinator to join a not-for-profit organisation based in Bradford, supporting its Children and Young People (CYP) services. This is a 6-month fixed-term role, with the possibility of extending depending on service requirements . You'll provide important operational and administrative support during a period of workforce transition, vacancies and staff absence, helping to keep things running smoothly across the service. What will you be doing? As a Service Coordinator, you'll support a range of operational processes, including: Completing case file audits, file closure reviews and service activity spot checks. Maintaining audit records and following up on outstanding actions. Supporting accurate record keeping and compliance with service procedures. Monitoring incidents and safeguarding concerns, ensuring actions are followed up and recorded appropriately. Maintaining incident and safeguarding trackers and escalating overdue actions where needed. Monitoring referrals, caseloads and waiting lists across CYP services. Keeping databases, records and trackers accurate and up to date. Supporting data quality checks and producing routine operational reports. Coordinating staff rotas, cover arrangements and workforce records. What are we looking for? You'll need previous experience in an administrative, coordination or operational support role, along with: Maintaining databases, trackers and records. Producing reports and monitoring information. Spporting quality assurance or audit processes. Knowledge of safeguarding within children's, health, social care or voluntary sector settings. Strong organisational and IT skills. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities. Confidence using databases, spreadsheets and reporting systems. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively across different teams. You'll be organised, reliable and comfortable keeping on top of several priorities at once. This is a role where accuracy, follow-through and good communication are important. What's on offer? Flexible/hybrid working in line with service requirements . 6-month fixed-term contract, with potential to extend. 25 days' annual leave, increasing to 28 days with length of service, plus bank holidays (pro rata). Up to two additional wellbeing days each year. Simply Health Cash Plan, including support towards dental, optical, prescriptions and physiotherapy costs. Employee Assistance Service with 24/7 confidential mental health support and access to structured therapy sessions. Generous pension scheme and employer contribution. Discount schemes including Company Shop and Blue Light Card. Personal development opportunities, including access to Clinical Supervision. Enhanced sick pay after six-month probation. Accredited employer with Mindful Employer, Disability Confident and Real Living Wage
